projects.name: Vehicle Data Services
projects.summary: Vehicle Data Services (VDS) collects vehicle information such as vehicle dimensions, service part details, service history and fuel tank capacity from various BOM sources and maps it to each vehicle's unique identification number (VIN). It holds historical data at a scale of billions to trillions of records in BigQuery, which makes the system complex but powerful. Internal vehicle engineers and dealers use it to deploy the carmon function to targeted vehicles through sampling, and to look up part details for any vehicle model.
